jobs.title: Credit Analyst / Credit Officer
jobs.description:
Role Description We are seeking analytical and finance-oriented professionals for the positions of Credit Analyst / Credit Officer
. These roles focus on credit risk assessment, financial evaluation, lending support, credit portfolio monitoring, and the management of credit-related activities. The ideal candidates should demonstrate strong financial knowledge, numerical abilities, critical thinking, and an understanding of lending principles, credit policies, and risk management practices.
Responsibilities include reviewing credit applications, evaluating financial statements, assessing borrowers' repayment capacity, and analyzing creditworthiness based on financial information and supporting documentation. Professionals will conduct credit risk assessments, review income and cash flow information, evaluate existing financial obligations, and prepare credit evaluation reports to support lending decisions. Additional duties include monitoring credit accounts, identifying potential repayment risks, reviewing credit limits, maintaining accurate customer records, and ensuring that credit assessments comply with internal policies and applicable regulatory requirements. They will also coordinate with relationship managers, banking operations teams, and relevant departments to clarify financial information, resolve documentation issues, and support effective credit management processes.
Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Banking, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of credit analysis, lending procedures, and financial risk management.
Knowledge of financial statement analysis, cash flow assessment, and credit evaluation.
Ability to assess borrowers' financial positions and repayment capacity.
Familiarity with credit reports, loan documentation, and credit monitoring procedures.
Understanding of banking regulations, credit policies, and internal control requirements.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial analysis tools.
Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication, report-writing, and documentation skills.
High attention to detail, professional integrity, and sound financial judgment.

jobs.title: Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description
Mannat Homes Real Estate LLC is a Dubai-based brokerage specializing in residential, commercial, and investment properties across the UAE and global markets. The firm combines deep local market expertise with a client-first approach, offering tailored advice for buyers, investors, landlords, and tenants. Professionals at Mannat Homes provide strategic guidance, transparent communication, and streamlined transactions to help clients make confident property decisions. Built on integrity, innovation, and long-term relationships, the company is committed to delivering results that align with each client’s real estate goals. Team members work in a dynamic environment that values collaboration, market insight, and customer success.
Role Description
The Portfolio Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, responsible for managing and optimizing client real estate portfolios. Day-to-day activities include analyzing property performance, assessing market trends, and recommending strategic acquisition, disposal, and leasing decisions to maximize returns and mitigate risk. The role involves preparing portfolio reports, financial models, and investment proposals, as well as monitoring cash flows, rental yields, and asset valuations. The Portfolio Manager will collaborate with sales, leasing, and finance teams to execute portfolio strategies, maintain strong client relationships, and respond to client inquiries with data-driven insights. Additional responsibilities include supporting due diligence for new investments, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations, and contributing to continuous improvement of portfolio management processes.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret market data, evaluate property performance, and support data-driven decisions.
Candidates should possess Finance and Investments skills to build financial models, assess returns, and understand real estate investment structures.
Candidates should possess Portfolio Management skills to design, implement, and monitor strategies across diverse property holdings.
Candidates should possess Trading-related skills for executing buy, sell, and lease transactions aligned with portfolio objectives.
Relevant experience in real estate, asset management, or investment advisory, preferably within the UAE or GCC region.
Strong communication and client relationship skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly to stakeholders.
Proficiency in Excel and financial analysis tools; familiarity with real estate CRM or portfolio management systems is an advantage.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Real Estate, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CFA, RERA) are beneficial.
Ability to work on-site in Dubai, manage multiple priorities, and adapt to a fast-paced, dynamic market environment.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Summary
Al Bakrawe Holding is looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Financial Analyst to join our team in Dubai. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and business performance evaluation.
The candidate will be responsible for analyzing financial data, identifying trends, monitoring profitability, controlling costs, and providing accurate financial insights to support management decision-making.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze financial statements, financial performance, and business trends.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.
Develop and monitor budgets, financial forecasts, and financial models.
Conduct budget versus actual analysis and investigate financial variances.
Monitor revenue, expenses, gross profit, and net profit margins.
Analyze product, customer, and business unit profitability.
Monitor cash flow, working capital, accounts receivable, and accounts payable.
Evaluate inventory costs, operational expenses, and financial efficiency.
Identify financial risks, cost-saving opportunities, and areas for improvement.
Prepare financial dashboards, reports, and presentations for management.
Provide recommendations to improve profitability and business performance.
Coordinate with Accounting, Finance, Procurement, and Operations departments.
